custom-checkpoints-enabled.name: Custom Checkpoints (partially working)
custom-checkpoints-enabled.description: Enable custom checkpoint visuals in practice mode.

checkpoint-outer-color-enabled.name: Custom Outer Color
checkpoint-outer-color-enabled.description: Use a custom color for the outer checkpoint.

checkpoint-outer-color.name: Outer Checkpoint Color
checkpoint-outer-color.description: RGB color for the outer checkpoint.

checkpoint-inner-color-enabled.name: Custom Inner Color
checkpoint-inner-color-enabled.description: Use a custom color for the inner checkpoint.

checkpoint-inner-color.name: Inner Checkpoint Color
checkpoint-inner-color.description: RGB color for the inner checkpoint.

checkpoint-rainbow-enabled.name: Rainbow Mode
checkpoint-rainbow-enabled.description: Each checkpoint placed gets the next color in the rainbow sequence.

checkpoint-fade-enabled.name: Checkpoint Fade
checkpoint-fade-enabled.description: Each successive checkpoint placed becomes more transparent.

checkpoint-fade-step.name: Fade Step
checkpoint-fade-step.description: How much opacity is reduced per checkpoint placement.

checkpoint-fade-min.name: Minimum Fade Opacity
checkpoint-fade-min.description: Opacity floor — checkpoints will never go below this value.

checkpoint-fadein-enabled.name: Fade-In on Placement
checkpoint-fadein-enabled.description: Checkpoints fade in from transparent when placed.

checkpoint-fadein-duration.name: Fade-In Duration
checkpoint-fadein-duration.description: How long the fade-in animation takes in seconds.

checkpoint-image.name: Custom Checkpoint Image
checkpoint-image.description: Optional custom image for checkpoints. When set, the checkpoint uses only this image and does not apply recoloring.

checkpoint-sfx-path.name: Checkpoint Place Sound
checkpoint-sfx-path.description: Path to the checkpoint placement sound.

checkpoint-remove-sfx-path.name: Checkpoint Remove Sound
checkpoint-remove-sfx-path.description: Path to the checkpoint removal sound.

checkpoint-restriction.name: Ignore Restrictions
checkpoint-restriction.description: Ignore the game's checkpoint placement restrictions.

practice-coins-enabled.name: Practice Coins
practice-coins-enabled.description: Allow coins to be collected in practice mode.

checkpoint-behind-player.name: Checkpoints Behind Player
checkpoint-behind-player.description: Render practice checkpoints behind the player.

practice-respawn-time-enabled.name: Custom Practice Respawn Time
practice-respawn-time-enabled.description: Add a delay before respawning from a checkpoint in practice mode.

practice-respawn-time.name: Respawn Delay (seconds)
practice-respawn-time.description: How long to wait after death before loading the checkpoint.

blue-check-enabled.name: Blue Practice Completion
blue-check-enabled.description: Show practice completion checkmarks and percentages. (will expand later)
